description: This file defines the CatalogItem class within the BlazorShared.Models namespace. It includes properties representing a catalog item's details such as ID, type, brand, name, description, price, and associated image data, along with methods for image validation and data conversion.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents a catalog item with properties such as ID, catalog type, brand, name, description, price, and image data. Includes methods for validating images and converting image files to base64 format.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates whether the provided image filename and base64 string represent a valid image of specified types and size constraints.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Asynchronously reads an IFileListEntry file item and converts its data stream into a base64 encoded string.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension of the provided filename matches allowed image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
